review_description: Very confusing every one tells you a different story.Your information was very helpfull it enabled me to at least arsk the right questions.Thank You.
Your advice was very helpful and also the "whirlpool " net site  green energy made aware many of the pitfalls and areas to watch for.Again , thanks for providing the service that got us going.

Biggest fear is that the supplier is reputable. He seemed to have all the answers. Was doing it before solar became fashionable! No definite time for installation, I haven't heard from him since I signed up, nearly a month. Sole trader so was able to match prices and inclusions and was local.I had done my homework so hopefully knew the questions to ask and I wanted European components (they have been manufacturing for some time now)
